Perfect! The text is very readable. Here's the final explanation:

## What this letter says

You had a blood test called HbA1c on 29 September 2026. This test shows your average blood sugar over the last 2 to 3 months. Your result was 52 mmol/mol.

Results of 48 mmol/mol or above are in the range for type 2 diabetes. Your result means type 2 diabetes is possible.

You do not have any symptoms of diabetes right now. Because of this, your doctor needs a second blood test. This test will help confirm whether you have diabetes. No diagnosis has been made yet.

## What you need to do

1. Book a repeat blood test with the practice nurse within the next 2 weeks.
2. Book an appointment with Dr Thompson after the second test to discuss the result.
3. You do not need to fast for this repeat test.
4. Do not start any new medicine for diabetes before you have spoken to the doctor.

## Dates and medicines

**Blood test result:**
- HbA1c blood test: 29 September 2026. Result: 52 mmol/mol.

No medicines are mentioned in this letter.

## Questions to ask your doctor

- What is type 2 diabetes?
- What will the second blood test show?
- When will I get the results of the second test?
- What will happen if the second test shows the same result?

## When to get urgent help

The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
